<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const canvas=document.querySelector('#world'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),mini=document.querySelector('#minimap'),mctx=mini.getContext('2d');
const W=42,H=34,T=48,keys=new Set();let cw=800,ch=600,dpr=1,last=0,encounter=null,toastTimer=0,walk=0;
const player={x:W*T*.54,y:H*T*.55,speed:190,face:'down'};
let inventory={orbs:5,berries:3},party=[],xp=43,level=4,caught=0,found={},active=false;
const species=[{name:'Mossbun',icon:'🐰',type:'Grove',color:'#9ac881',hp:30},{name:'Cindercub',icon:'🦊',type:'Ember',color:'#e99568',hp:34},{name:'Dewdrop',icon:'🐸',type:'Tide',color:'#7eb9b1',hp:27},{name:'Pufflet',icon:'🐥',type:'Breeze',color:'#e6ca70',hp:25},{name:'Pebblit',icon:'🐢',type:'Grove',color:'#a5a973',hp:38},{name:'Glimmeray',icon:'🦋',type:'Breeze',color:'#b8a0d4',hp:23}];
let wild=[],berries=[],trees=[],players=[],seed=8401;const rand=()=>{seed=(seed*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296};
// Hand-shaped paths and clearings keep the meadow readable while the world stays open.
function pathDistance(x,y){const pts=[[0,21],[8,19],[15,17],[23,17],[30,14],[38,12],[42,9]];let best=999;for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++){let [ax,ay]=pts[i],[bx,by]=pts[i+1],dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-ax)*dx+(y-ay)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy)));best=Math.min(best,Math.hypot(x-(ax+t*dx),y-(ay+t*dy)))}return best}
function isPath(x,y){return pathDistance(x,y)<1.9}
for(let i=0;i<190;i++){let x=2+rand()*(W-4),y=2+rand()*(H-4);if(!isPath(x,y)&&Math.hypot(x-W*.54,y-H*.55)>2)trees.push({x,y,size:.65+rand()*.65,kind:rand()})}
for(let i=0;i<18;i++){let x=3+rand()*(W-6),y=3+rand()*(H-6);if(!isPath(x,y))berries.push({x:x*T,y:y*T,taken:false,rare:rand()<.22})}
for(let i=0;i<22;i++){let x=3+rand()*(W-6),y=3+rand()*(H-6);if(!isPath(x,y))wild.push({x:x*T,y:y*T,sp:species[Math.floor(rand()*species.length)],vx:0,vy:0,phase:rand()*8})}
const names=['BirchBard','MallowMint','JuniperJay','Cloudberry','WrenWander'];for(let i=0;i<5;i++)players.push({x:(8+rand()*27)*T,y:(5+rand()*23)*T,name:names[i],icon:['🧑🏻‍🌾','👩🏽‍🦱','🧑🏾‍🎤','👩🏻‍🌾','🧑🏼‍🦰'][i],phase:rand()*9,dx:0,dy:0});
function resize(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);cw=r.width;ch=r.height;canvas.width=Math.floor(cw*dpr);canvas.height=Math.floor(ch*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);mini.width=248;mini.height=188}new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);resize();
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function drawTree(x,y,size,time){let s=T*size;ctx.fillStyle='#496d48';ctx.fillRect(x-s*.09,y-s*.08,s*.18,s*.45);ctx.fillStyle='#2e6048';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y-s*.2,s*.47,s*.44,0,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#54845a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x-s*.1,y-s*.32,s*.34,s*.29,0,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#78a269';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x-s*.17,y-s*.38,s*.15,s*.11,0,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff18';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x-s*.19,y-s*.16,s*.12,s*.22,-.4,0,7);ctx.fill();}
function worldPos(){return{x:clamp(player.x-cw/2,0,W*T-cw),y:clamp(player.y-ch/2,0,H*T-ch)}}
function draw(){const cam=worldPos(),t=performance.now()/1000;ctx.clearRect(0,0,cw,ch);ctx.save();ctx.translate(-cam.x,-cam.y);ctx.fillStyle='#8eb47b';ctx.fillRect(cam.x,cam.y,cw,ch);
// soft watercolor grass tiles
for(let y=Math.floor(cam.y/T)-1;y<Math.ceil((cam.y+ch)/T)+1;y++)for(let x=Math.floor(cam.x/T)-1;x<Math.ceil((cam.x+cw)/T)+1;x++){let h=((x*7+y*13+x*y*3)%17+17)%17;if(isPath(x+.5,y+.5)){ctx.fillStyle='#c8c58a';ctx.fillRect(x*T,y*T,T,T);ctx.fillStyle='#d5d09a';ctx.fillRect(x*T+((x*13)%28),y*T+((y*9)%30),13,5)}else{ctx.fillStyle=['#88af76','#91b881','#83a971','#94b67a'][h%4];ctx.fillRect(x*T,y*T,T,T);if(h%3===0){ctx.fillStyle='#d0d77f';ctx.fillRect(x*T+10+h%16,y*T+13,3,5);ctx.fillStyle='#e7e9ae';ctx.fillRect(x*T+12+h%16,y*T+11,3,3)}if(h%4===0){ctx.fillStyle='#638d64';ctx.fillRect(x*T+31,y*T+33,4,3)}}}
// water pond in northeast corner
ctx.fillStyle='#7db8b1';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(32*T,5*T,4.2*T,2.4*T,-.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#a5d4c2';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(32*T,5*T,3.8*T,2.1*T,-.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ctx.strokeStyle='#d2ebcf70';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(32*T+(i-2)*22,5*T+(i%2)*14,24,7,0,0,7);ctx.stroke()}
// flower patches and collectible berries
berries.forEach(b=>{if(b.taken)return;let x=b.x,y=b.y;ctx.fillStyle='#4b7552';ctx.fillRect(x-2,y-1,4,10);ctx.fillStyle=b.rare?'#e98e9d':'#e5c968';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-5,6,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff4c4';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-2,y-7,2,0,7);ctx.fill()});
trees.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y).forEach(a=>drawTree(a.x*T,a.y*T,a.size,t));
// creature silhouettes in tall grass
wild.forEach(w=>{if(w.hidden)return;let bob=Math.sin(t*2+w.phase)*2;ctx.fillStyle='#36574040';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(w.x,w.y+11,15,5,0,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.font='27px serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(w.sp.icon,w.x,w.y+bob+7);if(Math.hypot(w.x-player.x,w.y-player.y)<95){ctx.fillStyle='#fffde5';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(w.x,w.y-24,3,0,7);ctx.fill()}});
players.forEach((p,i)=>{let bob=Math.sin(t*2+p.phase)*2;ctx.fillStyle='#284a3c30';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p.x,p.y+13,14,5,0,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.font='25px serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(p.icon,p.x,p.y+bob+7);ctx.font='9px DM Mono';ctx.fillStyle='#f8f6df';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(p.name,p.x,p.y-17)});
// player avatar
ctx.fillStyle='#36513f50';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(player.x,player.y+13,15,5,0,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.font='28px serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('🧢',player.x,player.y+8+Math.sin(t*9)*1.5);ctx.restore();drawMini();requestAnimationFrame(draw)}
function drawMini(){mctx.clearRect(0,0,248,188);mctx.fillStyle='#94b77d';mctx.fillRect(0,0,248,188);mctx.fillStyle='#c9c88f';mctx.beginPath();mctx.moveTo(0,118);mctx.lineTo(45,105);mctx.lineTo(90,94);mctx.lineTo(135,94);mctx.lineTo(185,75);mctx.lineTo(228,65);mctx.lineTo(248,48);mctx.lineTo(248,66);mctx.lineTo(190,93);mctx.lineTo(140,113);mctx.lineTo(90,112);mctx.lineTo(45,124);mctx.lineTo(0,137);mctx.fill();mctx.fillStyle='#7db8b1';mctx.beginPath();mctx.ellipse(191,26,27,17,-.3,0,7);mctx.fill();trees.forEach(o=>{mctx.fillStyle='#497354';mctx.fillRect(o.x/W*248,o.y/H*188,3,3)});mctx.fillStyle='#f7f6df';mctx.beginPath();mctx.arc(player.x/(W*T)*248,player.y/(H*T)*188,5,0,7);mctx.fill();mctx.strokeStyle='#41644d';mctx.lineWidth=2;mctx.stroke()}
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
